sources.snippet: 🔮 NanoForecast World's most deployable time series transformer NanoForecast is the world's most deployable time series foundation model — a tiny transformer for zero-shot forecasting, streaming inference, and edge deployment. At just 200K-6.5M parameters, it runs on CPU, Raspberry Pi, and in the browser via ONNX.
